provenance.source_title: Your Life After Marrying Into Royalty

voice_persona.name: 冷面说书人（温情版：替你预演一生的旁白）
voice_persona.description: 一个平静宣读你人生档案的叙述者：全程第二人称现在时，用极短句与具体画面把你逐级送上隐秘圈层的爬梯；对王室不惊叹、对寒酸不怜悯，体量差全部交给画面三拍与同单位对照；判词简短温柔，像一位知道结局的老朋友在你耳边预演
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 把观众当作当事人本人：不是「给你讲一个童话」，而是「这就是你将过的人生」，亲密到像在替你回忆
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自细节的可信（宫廷规则、考验机制、家族打法）与预言式的确定语气

tone_profile.certainty_style: 全部用确定语气陈述（You will / It is），判词用最小单位、镜像句或单字句独立落下；不写模糊感慨

rhythm_rules.rule: 极短句连续推进（平均7.9词，短句占69%），一个动作一句
rhythm_rules.function: 保持档案宣读式的宿命节拍

rhythm_rules.rule: 阶层差用画面三拍与同单位对照（黑车/大汉/士兵式点头、小戒指 vs 一座山）
情绪判词用最小单位、镜像句或单字句独立落下（An inch is everything.）
开场意象在中后段逐一召回（咖啡馆/小杯茶/小戒指/修水管的父亲）
rhythm_rules.function: 用复现制造时间纵深与主题回扣

rhythm_rules.rule: 级间用章节卡硬切（Level X, the [身份]），身份即处境预告

pause_and_emphasis: 判词用单句成段（They cheer the story, not you.）
真相用短句直给（Her father is a king.）
章节卡后接年龄/处境定格（You are 34 and you have led nothing this large.）
transition_style: 章节卡硬切（Level five, the apprentice.）
时间跳转声明（A year passes faster than you expect.）
信物转场（Then a letter arrives with a royal seal.）
计划外事件转折（Then the cameras leave and real life begins.）
循环回收（Somewhere out there, a young man is sitting across from a woman...）

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 极低频：仅开场恋爱段与阶级错位处一两处
placement_rules: 自己铺床被仆人温和制止的阶级错位小幽默
「这感觉维持约1周」式幸福限时器
avoid_rules: 不嘲笑任何一方的出身
病重、葬礼与托付段落绝对不用幽默

language_patterns.formula: Level X, the [身份]. You are [年龄] years old.
The heater breaks every single winter. Your one good jacket is fraying at the cuffs.
language_patterns.purpose: 用年年如此的小破损写经济层

language_patterns.formula: She orders the same small tea you do. You do not understand that kindness yet.
language_patterns.purpose: 先写动作再标注「以后才懂」

language_patterns.formula: A black car waits at the corner. Two large men stand beside it. They nod to her like soldiers.
language_patterns.purpose: 不给答案先给三个异常画面

language_patterns.formula: Her father is a king. You laugh because it must be a joke. She does not laugh at all.
language_patterns.purpose: 用一方笑一方不笑让荒诞落地为真

language_patterns.formula: Then a letter arrives with a royal seal. You are summoned to the palace.
language_patterns.purpose: 用权威信物把幻想切换成征召

language_patterns.formula: The building is not a house. It is a fortress with towers and a name.
You would have signed a hundred pages to keep her.
language_patterns.purpose: 用「愿意做一百倍」证明动机纯度

language_patterns.formula: They cheer a man they have never met. They cheer the story, not you.
language_patterns.purpose: 把盛大场面翻成孤独现场

language_patterns.formula: Every dinner is an exam you never studied for.
language_patterns.purpose: 把日常场景重命名为非自愿考核

language_patterns.formula: You earn 1 inch of his trust. An inch is everything.
language_patterns.purpose: 用最小单位放大进展的重量

language_patterns.formula: Each secret you bury makes you more necessary. Each secret you bury also makes you more alone.
language_patterns.purpose: 同因双果记权力的收入与成本

language_patterns.formula: No royalty came to a plumber's funeral. That absence told you everything about loyalty.
language_patterns.purpose: 只写谁没来，让缺席下判词

language_patterns.formula: blood built this crown, but blood will not keep it standing.
language_patterns.purpose: 用同一词承担建与毁写传承悖论

language_patterns.formula: The money was never the point. The crown was never the point. That was the secret the whole time.
language_patterns.purpose: 同构否定连击两层宏大后收束

language_patterns.formula: Somewhere out there, a young man is sitting across from a woman in a quiet cafe.

preferred_traits: 可拍照的具体物件（fraying cuffs、small tea、royal seal、white gloves）
同单位对照（小戒指 vs a mountain of them、宫翼 vs 整个小镇）
avoid_traits: 童话式形容词（magical/fairytale/dream come true）
操作指南式的权斗细节

forbidden_style.rule: 情绪必须用画面、数字与事实承载，禁止形容词直给
病重、葬礼与托付段落绝对不用幽默
主题落点必须在人不在权位，禁止童话式收束
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华
禁止把阶层跃迁写成无代价童话

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
